# Sotto Voce

> Sotto Voce is a private dictation keyboard and speech-to-text app for iPhone, made by Daniel Li. Speech is transcribed on the iPhone itself: audio is never uploaded, it works offline once its speech models have downloaded, and there is no account. It types into any app. Free for 1,000 words a week; Sotto Voce Pro removes the limit. Requires iOS 26. English.

- [Homepage](https://sottovoce.uk/): what it does, privacy, plans and an FAQ
- [Support](https://sottovoce.uk/support.html): setting up the keyboard, Full Access, Pro
- [Privacy policy](https://sottovoce.uk/privacy.html)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sotto-voce/id6808935928)
